text_block_list.text:
Finally, it's time for Фудзи Кисэки's debut
race.

"Here's Фудзи Кисэки! She's already made
quite a
name for herself before her
debut. Rumor has it
she had a whole
crowd of trainers vying to work
with her."
text_block_list.name: Announcer A

text_block_list.text:
"That must mean her current trainer is
the cream
of the crop!"
text_block_list.name: Announcer B

text_block_list.text:
"That may be so! Now, I don't know
about you,
but I can't wait to see how
they do today!"
text_block_list.name: Announcer A

text_block_list.text:
Even though this is Фудзи Кисэки's race, a
great deal
of attention is suddenly
turned on me too.

Let me cast a charm on you real quick,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's a special spell that will fill you with
courage.
Give me your hand.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I hold out my right hand as asked, and
she takes
it between both of hers.

I know you well. You're brave and wise
and warm.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
When I release your hand, your heart
will brim
with courage. When you look
up, you'll see a
rainbow.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I'm going to let go now.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: She releases her grip on me slowly.

I feel something resting in my palm, and
when I
check, I realize it's a piece of
wrapped chocolate.

Chocolate is supposed to settle the
nerves. Think
of it as a bonus.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Oh, I'd better go now. I'll see you later.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки exits the room with a gallant
flourish.

My right hand is warm and the chocolate
is sweet.
Next thing I know, I'm no
longer nervous at all.
